verdict.rationale: Kong ships a first-party Rate Limiting plugin (kong-docs-64), and its README lists plugins for traffic controls and rate limiting (kong-gh-3). AI Gateway docs separately describe enforcing rate limits on proxied AI traffic (kong-docs-58), so rate limiting at the gateway is clearly a native capability. missing for 10: explicit evidence of per-consumer and per-route scoping (the plugin page appears only as a title), configuration details such as limit windows or counter policies, and independent hands-on corroboration.
